findings.category: sidecar hint deviation, recorded not churned
findings.adjudication: resolved (nominal form applied); hint deviation recorded
findings.reason: The applied values are the ones the finding asked for, and they are better than what they replace: Urdu is verb-final, so a finite predicate in front of the tool name reads as a verb followed by an afterthought, while «کال جاری» / «کال مکمل» compose as a label before the object in the RTL row. Both halves use words the corpus already owns for a call - «ٹول کال», «ہر فراہم کنندہ کال», «ماڈل کالز» - and جاری (91 values) / مکمل (119 values) are the established in-progress / complete pair. Recorded here so the next reader does not mistake a hint for a violation: the sidecars for these two keys say «present participle … one word» and «past tense … one word», and the values are two-word nominals. That is the Hindi sibling's shape too (कॉल जारी / कॉल पूर्ण), and the row's actual budget - the verb column is `shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap`, documented as 'at most three short words' (tool-row.tsx:928) - is met with room to spare. No value change; optionally amend the two sidecar tone lines to «nominal label in SOV locales (hi/ur)».

findings.reason: The earlier finding compared this line with the picker_host footers and concluded the English full stop was the odd one out. The call site says otherwise: in the slash popup this line and a click line are ONE bordered strip with two lines - `slash-commands.tsx:2258-2267` renders `{footerText}` then `{clickText}` in that order - and the click line in the same strip ends with a stop in ur («کلک کرنے سے /{label} چل جائے گی۔»). Every English line of that strip ends with '.', including the hardcoded siblings `Enter runs /${label}.` / `Enter completes /{label}.` (`enterFooter`, slash-contract.ts:1237-1272). The wave's own practice for this key is visible in the same commit: Hindi, which carries the identical sidecar line «instruction, sentence case, no trailing period», gained the Devanagari stop । in a5356ce91c while keeping the rest of its value. Urdu is now the only SOV sibling whose line ends bare, and it ends bare directly above a line that does not. Adding ۔ costs one character, keeps the ':' and '·' structure, and leaves the sidecar's other clauses intact. If the coordinator prefers the sidecar's 'no trailing period', the coherent fix is source-side and wider: drop the stop from the English value AND from the click.* lines in all seven locales. Fixing it in ur alone in the other direction is not available, because the adjacent line keeps its stop.

Not counted: no wave-B value is wrong, and the gap predates this commit (unchanged bytes at 0559f7f7d8). Named so the ur popup is not assumed complete.

findings.reason: The applied change fixes what the finding named: «سست روی سے» is the abstract news register, and «آہستہ» is the plain adverb a status strip wants. Meaning, subject (the server, not the reader) and the queued consequence are all correct, so this is not a re-audit of the old defect. Two notes, both below the old nit in weight: the corpus's adjective for a slow link is سست, not آہستہ («سست یا رکا ہوا کنکشن», ui.common.updates.check_for_updates_button…; 7 values), so سست carries the established technical register; and آہستہ attached to a verb of speech also carries 'softly / quietly', which the second sentence disambiguates but does not remove. «دیر سے جواب دے رہا ہے» ('answers late') is unambiguous and corpus-shaped. Optional at nit level.

adjudication_of_previous_findings.detail: «اطلاع بند کریں» replaces the ٹوسٹ coinage. Checked independently: ٹوسٹ is now 0 across all 6,085 shipped ur values, اطلاع (singular) carries 'notice/notification' in 17 values including the dismiss family («ڈاؤن لوڈ کی اطلاع ہٹائیں», «اپ ڈیٹ کی اطلاع ہٹائیں»), بند کریں is the corpus's close verb (72 values, e.g. ui.agentMessages.dialog.close), and the toast region label in the same component is اطلاعات. Singular noun for one toast, plural region for the region - correct. Accessible name only (themed-toast-container.tsx:95), so this phrase is the whole of what a screen reader announces.

All four placeholder footers are now feminine, and the family is coherent rather than uniform: نام (m) keeps گا in chooses_name, {name} (the MCP server, m) keeps گا in connects, قدر (f) keeps گی in completes_value, and the four command footers now agree feminine with کمانڈ - which the corpus treats as feminine («آرگیومنٹ لینے والی کمانڈز…») and which runs_command already used. Corpus has 6 feminine «ہو جائے گی» values beside 8 masculine ones, so the form is not novel. Meaning unchanged in all four; 'runs' vs 'completes' vs 'stages' stay distinct.
Nominal form applied; see UR-WBD-03 for the recorded sidecar-hint deviation.
سست روی سے replaced; see UR-WBD-02.

«یا اگر وہ بند ہی رہے تو ایپ دوبارہ شروع کریں۔» is the idiomatic 'if it stays shut' and agrees masculine with سرور. Both remedies, their order, the em dash and the 'never state a cause' rule are intact; nothing in the sentence blames the reader.

The translator declined, following the sidecar's «no trailing period». Overruled on call-site evidence: the line shares one strip with a click line that carries ۔, every English line of that strip carries '.', and Hindi added । for this key in this same commit. See UR-WBD-01.

«بھیجنے میں تاخیر ہو گی۔» states what happens to the send instead of putting an obligation on the reader, keeps both keys identical (one fact, one wording), and follows the corpus's own «… میں تاخیر ہو …» construction (ui.schedules.scheduled_task_dialog…). The internet_offline subject is still THIS machine, which the sidecar singles out.

verdict.summary: Six of the seven earlier findings are resolved and verified independently; UR-WB-01, the only major, is fixed. UR-WB-06 is overruled - ur should carry the terminal stop the strip's other line and the English already carry (one minor). Two nits and two uncounted observations. No blocker, no major, so the nine namespaces can be recorded as clean-with-findings.
